Methods

Data

The 2 sections (S01 and S02) were profiled on the 10x Genomics Xenium platform [1] with the Xenium Human Lung panel, and their outputs analyzed by Xenium Onboard Analysis 2.0.0 (xenium-2.0.0.10): 101 to 102 cells and 1,001 to 1,002 decoded transcripts a section, as the instrument segmented them. Each output bundle was read with SituCraft 0.8.0 (commit abcdef1) [2], whose own readers decoded every file, and checked: 0 fatal problems and 2 warnings in all, and 10 of the 10 values the runs recorded recomputed from their data alike.

Cell types

The cells of each of S01 and S02 were clustered as scanpy's defaults do [2–4]: the cells with at least 10 gene transcripts, each scaled to the median total and log-transformed, and each gene scaled; 50 principal components; a graph of each cell's 15 nearest neighbors; and Leiden communities of modularity at a resolution of 1 (seed 20250), each cluster's markers found by the rank-sum test. This gave 5 clusters of 91 cells (S01) and 6 clusters of 92 cells (S02). Cell types were defined by the marker set "Lung" (version 1: 2 labels; one of SituCraft's starter sets) [5, 6]. The cells of each of S01 and S02 were labeled from the marker set's markers [2, 3, 5–7]: each label's markers scored against control genes of similar expression, as scanpy's score_genes does (the genes cut into 25 bins by mean expression, 50 controls drawn from the bin of each of a label's markers, a label's lineage's markers left out of its controls; seed 20250), a cell taking a level's best label when it scored above 0 and led the next by 0.1. The cells labeled: 89.0% at the class level (S01) and 89.1% at the class level (S02).

Spatial analysis

A graph of the cells of each of S01 and S02 was built: cells whose centroids are neighbors in the Delaunay triangulation (found with exact geometric predicates) were joined, edges longer than 50 µm left out [2, 8]; 301 edges, a mean degree of 5.8 (S01) and 302 edges, a mean degree of 5.8 (S02). The neighborhood enrichment of the class labels of "Lung" (the cells of S01) was measured over the cells' graph [2, 9, 10]: for each pair of labels, the edges between their cells against those expected, each edge counting one, with a z-score and a p-value from 1,000 permutations of the labels (seed 7), the p-values adjusted by Benjamini and Hochberg's procedure: 2 of 3 pairs differed from chance (adjusted p below 0.05).

Samples compared

The samples (2 samples: S01 and S02) were compared by the design "By condition" (version 1), which reads: Compares condition: treated against control. Each sample was summarized [2, 11]: its cells chosen (its section's, or its region's; never those a review excluded), labeled by "Lung" (T cell and B cell); each label's cells counted, with their share of the labeled cells and their density per mm² of the sample's tissue (its outline closed by 10 µm); its quality; and its pseudobulk, each label's cells' gene transcripts summed gene by gene. Niches were found across the samples together: each cell's 10 nearest labeled cells described by their labels' shares, and the cells grouped by k-means into 6 niches (10 starts, 4 seeds compared; seed 20250). Each label's pseudobulk was compared between the groups [2, 12, 13], with the subject as the unit: the genes every panel has; each label's rows with at least 10 of its cells; genes filtered by expression; TMM's library sizes and voom's weights; each gene's weighted linear model of the design, its variance moderated; each contrast's log2 fold change with its 95% interval and moderated t; and p-values adjusted by Benjamini and Hochberg's procedure over every label, gene and contrast tested. Of 50 tests, 1 had an adjusted p below 0.05: CD3E (T cell; treated − control; log2 fold change +1.20, adjusted p 0.012).

The certificate

This report carries its certificate: the bundles the results rest on, by their files' SHA-256, and each step from them to the results, 16 in all (the record of each and the methods are in it too). It proves that these bundles, analyzed as recorded, give these files and numbers; not that the results are right. As the report opens it checks, offline, that the certificate is as certified and that each number, figure and paragraph here is the certificate's.

To check the results themselves, make them again: with SituCraft 0.8.0 or later, run situcraft verify --data <a folder holding the bundles> <this file>, which also checks this report against its certificate (or save the certificate, certificate-b7508c9a.zip, and give it instead).
